text:
maya: Quick sync — Snowflake + Databricks + vector DB partners: gating points + launch sequence. Need a single checklist and announcement windows. Anyone free now?

sam: I can own the gating matrix. Have a draft I'll share.

liam: SI integration leads need staging access for POC. Target: provisioning by early April (week of 4/6).

devin: Marketplace listing requires legal cert + DPA. Legal ETA is currently 4/10 if we push docs this week.

sara: Hardware bundle team: OEM testing slot open 4/8–4/10. We need partner sample specs & power/thermal numbers.

marcus-bizdev: From GTM: partners prefer GA announcement not beta. PR wants firm date; can we aim for 4/22 for joint go-live?

maya: 4/22 OK if cert + SI POCs + HW QAT all green. Blocking items I'm tracking: telemetry consent, E2E demo checklist, pricing SKUs for marketplace.

sam: I'll publish the checklist today. Will call out telemetry + data residency tests. Draft snippet:
```
- Certs: security review, legal sign-off (DPA)
- Functional: end-to-end query, cold-start latency, embedding parity
- Telemetry: opt-in flow + sample retention policy
- Performance: 90p latency targets, batching behavior
- Compatibility: Snowflake connector, Databricks runtime version, vector DB schema
- Marketplace: SKU mapping, pricing, terms
```

liam: SI timelines: two SIs asked for sample dataset and staging creds. I'll open invites and share infra link (internal staging) once sam posts checklist.

devin: Legal follow-up: need DPA + marketplace T&Cs. Also need to confirm whether customer telemetry could include PII for certain customers — flagging PCI compliance question.

sara: HW note: firmware sign-off required for the appliance bundle. Partner wants a QAT run ingesting ~10k docs (50GB) to validate indexing perf. Can we commit infra?

marcus-bizdev: PR wants embargo until 4/20, with a pre-brief with Snow/Databricks reps on 4/15. They prefer a single joint blog + partner quotes.

maya: Action items summary (assign): sam -> gating checklist, liam -> SI access & staging, devin -> legal certs/DPA, sara -> HW QAT schedule, marcus -> PR/embargo coordination.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar slot booked for 2026-04-15 10:00 PT — created by maya. :calendar:

sam: Noted. I'll drop the full checklist in this thread by EOD 2026-03-20.

liam: I'll provision staging and share creds by 2026-03-22.

devin: Legal aiming for sign-off by 2026-04-09; will escalate if we miss the doc deadline.

sara: QAT run planned 2026-04-08 -> 2026-04-10. Need sample dataset by 2026-03-25 from partner.

marcus-bizdev: I'll run the embargo logistics and draft partner PR outline. Will sync with partners week of 4/6 to lock quotes.

maya: Thanks team — keep updates here. If you hit blockers, ping me directly @maya. :+1:
